content.title: Recommendations for exercise rehabilitation in patients with chronic heart failure
content.summary: Guideline recommendations on exercise and supervised cardiac rehabilitation for patients with chronic heart failure.

recommendations.text: Exercise is recommended for all patients who are able in order to improve exercise capacity, QOL, and reduce HF hospitalization.
recommendations.notes: Applies to those who are able to adhere to the exercise programme (footnote c).

recommendations.text: A supervised, exercise-based, cardiac rehabilitation programme should be considered in patients with more severe disease, frailty, or with comorbidities.

footnotes.c: In those who are able to adhere to the exercise programme
